hypothesis: The replay-positive full state-surface satellite from exp-20260507-016 is currently blocked from live promotion by replay-only parity. The right next alpha step is to expose the same surface as a default-off production paper sleeve so forward replacement-value evidence can accumulate without changing core orders.
why_this_is_alpha_search: This advances the strongest positive alpha lead in the recent record instead of tuning thresholds or adding filters. It does not use LLM or earnings-soft-ranking data, so it avoids the current data-limited paths.

historical_context.positive_prior: exp-20260507-016 full state-surface satellite improved EV and PnL in all three canonical windows but was replay-only.
historical_context.rejected_prior: exp-20260507-017 pruned balanced_state_leadership and was rejected; this run deliberately keeps the full surface and changes only production-visible paper attribution.

measurement_caveat: The mid_weak after run showed yfinance earnings-calendar coverage drift from 38/45 to 37/45 despite no backtester, signal, risk, sizing, or order-path change. Treat that single-window core drift as existing earnings-data nondeterminism, not state-surface behavior.
gate_4_interpretation: This is not a live trading strategy promotion. Acceptance is based on no core order changes, shared production-visible attribution, parity disclosure, and tests proving trade_enabled=false/alters_orders=false. The prior alpha evidence remains exp-20260507-016.

production_impact.promotion_blocker: Live trading still requires a shared backtester adapter that consumes state_surface_sleeve.py plus forward paper outcomes clearing the gate.

next_valid_step: After at least 15 closed forward paper observations, compare state-surface candidates against cash and displaced core alternatives; only then build a shared backtester trade adapter.
